svg.aria-label: Five rows, each starting from C4 + E4. 1, Only upper rises, Oblique motion: C4 + F4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones. 2, Only lower falls, Oblique motion: B3 + E4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones. 3, Only lower rises, Oblique motion: D4 + E4, major second, 2 semitones. 4, Both move apart, Contrary motion: B3 + F4, diminished fifth, 6 semitones. 5, Both rise, Similar motion: D4 + F4, minor third, 3 semitones.
svg.title: The five changes, all from C4 + E4

g.text: Oblique motion · C4 + E4 → C4 + F4
Oblique motion · C4 + E4 → B3 + E4
Oblique motion · C4 + E4 → D4 + E4
Contrary motion · C4 + E4 → B3 + F4
Similar motion · C4 + E4 → D4 + F4
How to read this graphic: Every row begins
from C4 and E4 again; the changes do not
chain. Read across: the change in words, the
motion word, the end pair, then the interval
with its colour. Rows 1 and 2 share a colour
because they give the same interval size.
